description: A high-efficiency Gemini workhorse for coding, agents, and knowledge work. It improves first-pass code accuracy, multi-step tool use, and production-ready application output over Gemini 3.6 Flash.

i18n.en: A high-efficiency Gemini workhorse for coding, agents, and knowledge work. It improves first-pass code accuracy, multi-step tool use, and production-ready application output over Gemini 3.6 Flash.
i18n.zh: 面向编程、Agent 与知识工作的高效率 Gemini 主力模型。相较 Gemini 3.6 Flash，提升首轮代码准确率、多步工具调用与可上线应用产出。

description: A high-efficiency Gemini model for coding, agents, and web or application development. It focuses on polished coding and application outputs with fewer unnecessary edits across agentic workflows.

i18n.en: A high-efficiency Gemini model for coding, agents, and web or application development. It focuses on polished coding and application outputs with fewer unnecessary edits across agentic workflows.
i18n.zh: 面向编程、Agent、Web 与应用开发的高效率 Gemini 模型。面向 Agent 工作流中的编程与应用开发，力求以更少的无效修改产出更成熟的结果。

description: A frontier Gemini reasoning preview for software engineering and reliable agentic workflows. The preview improves software-engineering performance, agent reliability, and token efficiency across complex workflows.

i18n.en: A frontier Gemini reasoning preview for software engineering and reliable agentic workflows. The preview improves software-engineering performance, agent reliability, and token efficiency across complex workflows.
i18n.zh: 面向软件工程与高可靠 Agent 工作流的前沿 Gemini 推理预览模型。该预览版在复杂工作流中强化软件工程表现、Agent 可靠性和 Token 效率。

description: A fast Gemini thinking model for multi-turn chat, coding, and agent workflows. It offers near-Pro reasoning and tool use at Flash-class speed for multi-turn chat, coding, and agents.

i18n.en: A fast Gemini thinking model for multi-turn chat, coding, and agent workflows. It offers near-Pro reasoning and tool use at Flash-class speed for multi-turn chat, coding, and agents.
i18n.zh: 适合多轮对话、编程与 Agent 工作流的高速 Gemini 思考模型。以 Flash 级速度提供接近 Pro 的推理与工具调用能力，适用于多轮对话、编程和 Agent。

description: An efficient multimodal Gemini model with strong coding, reasoning, and parallel-agent performance. It brings near-Pro coding and reasoning to a faster tier and is tuned for parallel agent execution.

i18n.en: An efficient multimodal Gemini model with strong coding, reasoning, and parallel-agent performance. It brings near-Pro coding and reasoning to a faster tier and is tuned for parallel agent execution.
i18n.zh: 在编程、推理与并行 Agent 场景表现出色的高效 Gemini 多模态模型。在更高效的档位提供接近 Pro 的编程和推理能力，并针对并行 Agent 执行优化。

description: A lightweight Gemini model for focused subagents and high-volume production tasks. The lightweight design is especially suited to focused subagents inside larger multi-agent systems.

i18n.en: A lightweight Gemini model for focused subagents and high-volume production tasks. The lightweight design is especially suited to focused subagents inside larger multi-agent systems.
i18n.zh: 面向专注型子 Agent 与高流量生产任务的轻量 Gemini 模型。轻量化设计尤其适合大型多 Agent 系统中执行明确子任务的子 Agent。

description: A high-efficiency Gemini preview optimized for high-volume, latency-sensitive applications. It is tuned for high-volume workloads while approaching the quality of larger Flash models.

i18n.en: A high-efficiency Gemini preview optimized for high-volume, latency-sensitive applications. It is tuned for high-volume workloads while approaching the quality of larger Flash models.
i18n.zh: 针对高流量、延迟敏感应用优化的高效率 Gemini 预览模型。针对高吞吐工作负载优化，同时力求接近更大型 Flash 模型的质量。

description: A capable Gemini reasoning model for coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal analysis. Built-in thinking supports more deliberate answers across advanced coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal analysis.

i18n.en: A capable Gemini reasoning model for coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal analysis. Built-in thinking supports more deliberate answers across advanced coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal analysis.
i18n.zh: 适合编程、数学、科学与多模态分析的高性能 Gemini 推理模型。内置思考能力可在高级编程、数学、科学和多模态分析中给出更审慎的回答。

description: A versatile Gemini workhorse balancing reasoning quality, speed, and multimodal support. It balances built-in reasoning with workhorse throughput for coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal production tasks.

i18n.en: A versatile Gemini workhorse balancing reasoning quality, speed, and multimodal support. It balances built-in reasoning with workhorse throughput for coding, mathematics, science, and multimodal production tasks.
i18n.zh: 在推理质量、速度与多模态能力之间取得平衡的 Gemini 主力模型。在编程、数学、科学和多模态生产任务中平衡内置推理能力与主力级吞吐量。

description: A low-cost Gemini reasoning model optimized for throughput and fast token generation. The model prioritizes ultra-low latency, low cost, high throughput, and fast token generation.

i18n.en: A low-cost Gemini reasoning model optimized for throughput and fast token generation. The model prioritizes ultra-low latency, low cost, high throughput, and fast token generation.
i18n.zh: 针对高吞吐与快速生成优化的低成本 Gemini 推理模型。重点优化超低延迟、低成本、高吞吐和快速 Token 生成。
